archetypes.name: dyn-claude-pricing
archetypes.rationale: Model-specific pricing touches shared cost math and fallback paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed token pricing code for correct separation between main Claude model rates and Claude subprocess rates. Check the new Sonnet, Haiku, and Fable flag families, fallback handling for unknown models, and env override scope. Focus on whether legacy aggregate rows still price as before. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-token-ledger
archetypes.rationale: Ledger enrichment now maps historical raw Claude subprocess roles to model buckets.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the token ledger reporting and scan enrichment changes. Verify model-less claude_sub rows use exact raw role labels, explicit model rows win, and committed-ledger enrichment cannot corrupt existing canonical reports. Pay attention to compatibility with older token reports. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-run-summary
archetypes.rationale: Run summary callers now derive pricing identity from manifests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review PR body, final report, and progress-report pricing call sites. Confirm manifest model identity is used only for main-lane Claude pricing, explicit overrides win where intended, and rendered summary shapes remain stable. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
